verses.original: וַתָּ֣שַׁר דְּבוֹרָ֔ה וּבָרָ֖ק בֶּן־ אֲבִינֹ֑עַם בַּיּ֥וֹם הַה֖וּא לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tā·šar də·ḇō·w·rāh ū·ḇā·rāq ben- ’ă·ḇî·nō·‘am bay·yō·wm ha·hū lê·mōr
verses.literal: On that . . . day Deborah and Barak son of Abinoam sang this song
verses.literalPt: E CANTOU Débora e Baraque, filho de Abinoão, naquele mesmo dia, dizendo:

verses.original: בִּפְרֹ֤עַ פְּרָעוֹת֙ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בְּהִתְנַדֵּ֖ב עָ֑ם בָּרֲכ֖וּ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: bip̄·rō·a‘ pə·rā·‘ō·wṯ bə·yiś·rā·’êl bə·hiṯ·nad·dêḇ ‘ām bā·ră·ḵū Yah·weh
verses.literal: When the princes take the lead in Israel when the people volunteer bless the LORD
verses.literalPt: Louvai ao SENHOR pela vingança de Israel, quando o povo se ofereceu voluntariamente.

verses.original: שִׁמְע֣וּ מְלָכִ֔ים הַאֲזִ֖ינוּ רֹֽזְנִ֑ים אָֽנֹכִ֗י לַֽיהוָה֙ אָנֹכִ֣י אָשִׁ֔ירָה אֲזַמֵּ֕ר לַֽיהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: šim·‘ū mə·lā·ḵîm ha·’ă·zî·nū rō·zə·nîm ’ā·nō·ḵî Yah·weh ’ā·nō·ḵî ’ā·šî·rāh ’ă·zam·mêr Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Listen O kings Give ear O princes I will sing to the LORD . . . I will sing praise to the LORD the God of Israel
verses.literalPt: Ouvi, reis; dai ouvidos, príncipes; eu, eu cantarei ao SENHOR; salmodiarei ao SENHOR Deus de Israel.

verses.original: יְהוָ֗ה בְּצֵאתְךָ֤ מִשֵּׂעִיר֙ בְּצַעְדְּךָ֙ מִשְּׂדֵ֣ה אֱד֔וֹם אֶ֣רֶץ רָעָ֔שָׁה גַּם־ שָׁמַ֖יִם נָטָ֑פוּ גַּם־ עָבִ֖ים נָ֥טְפוּ מָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh bə·ṣê·ṯə·ḵā miś·śê·‘îr bə·ṣa‘·də·ḵā miś·śə·ḏêh ’ĕ·ḏō·wm ’e·reṣ rā·‘ā·šāh gam- šā·ma·yim nā·ṭā·p̄ū gam- ‘ā·ḇîm nā·ṭə·p̄ū mā·yim
verses.literal: O LORD when You went out from Seir when You marched from the land of Edom the earth trembled the heavens poured out rain and the clouds poured down water
verses.literalPt: Ó SENHOR, saindo tu de Seir, caminhando tu desde o campo de Edom, a terra estremeceu; até os céus gotejaram; até as nuvens gotejaram águas.

verses.original: הָרִ֥ים נָזְל֖וּ מִפְּנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה זֶ֣ה סִינַ֔י מִפְּנֵ֕י יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: hā·rîm nā·zə·lū mip·pə·nê Yah·weh zeh sî·nay mip·pə·nê Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: The mountains quaked before the LORD the One of Sinai before the LORD the God of Israel
verses.literalPt: Os montes se derreteram diante do SENHOR, e até Sinai diante do SENHOR Deus de Israel.

verses.original: בִּימֵ֞י שַׁמְגַּ֤ר בֶּן־ עֲנָת֙ בִּימֵ֣י יָעֵ֔ל חָדְל֖וּ אֳרָח֑וֹת וְהֹלְכֵ֣י נְתִיב֔וֹת יֵלְכ֕וּ אֳרָח֖וֹת עֲקַלְקַלּֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: bî·mê šam·gar ben- ‘ă·nāṯ bî·mê yā·‘êl ḥā·ḏə·lū ’o·rā·ḥō·wṯ wə·hō·lə·ḵê nə·ṯî·ḇō·wṯ yê·lə·ḵū ’o·rā·ḥō·wṯ ‘ă·qal·qal·lō·wṯ
verses.literal: In the days of Shamgar son of Anath in the days of Jael the highways were deserted and the travelers . . . took the byways
verses.literalPt: Nos dias de Sangar, filho de Anate, nos dias de Jael cessaram os caminhos; e os que andavam por veredas iam por caminhos torcidos.

verses.original: חָדְל֧וּ פְרָז֛וֹן בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל חָדֵ֑לּוּ עַ֤ד שַׁקַּ֙מְתִּי֙ דְּבוֹרָ֔ה שַׁקַּ֥מְתִּי אֵ֖ם בְּיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: ḥā·ḏə·lū p̄ə·rā·zō·wn bə·yiś·rā·’êl ḥā·ḏêl·lū ‘aḏ šaq·qam·tî də·ḇō·w·rāh šaq·qam·tî ’êm bə·yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Life in the villages ceased it ended in Israel until I, Deborah . . . arose a mother in Israel
verses.literalPt: Cessaram as aldeias em Israel, cessaram; até que eu, Débora, me levantei, por mãe em Israel me levantei.

verses.original: יִבְחַר֙ אֱלֹהִ֣ים חֲדָשִׁ֔ים אָ֖ז לָחֶ֣ם שְׁעָרִ֑ים מָגֵ֤ן אִם־ יֵֽרָאֶה֙ וָרֹ֔מַח בְּאַרְבָּעִ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף בְּיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: yiḇ·ḥar ’ĕ·lō·hîm ḥă·ḏā·šîm ’āz lā·ḥem šə·‘ā·rîm mā·ḡên ’im- yê·rā·’eh wā·rō·maḥ bə·’ar·bā·‘îm ’e·lep̄ bə·yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: When they chose new gods then war came to their gates Not a shield or spear was found among forty thousand in Israel
verses.literalPt: E se escolhia deuses novos, logo a guerra estava às portas; via-se por isso escudo ou lança entre quarenta mil em Israel?

verses.original: לִבִּי֙ לְחוֹקְקֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הַמִּֽתְנַדְּבִ֖ים בָּעָ֑ם בָּרֲכ֖וּ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: lib·bî lə·ḥō·wq·qê yiś·rā·’êl ham·miṯ·nad·də·ḇîm bā·‘ām bā·ră·ḵū Yah·weh
verses.literal: My heart is with the princes of Israel with the volunteers among the people Bless the LORD
verses.literalPt: Meu coração é para os legisladores de Israel, que voluntariamente se ofereceram entre o povo; bendizei ao SENHOR.

verses.original: רֹכְבֵי֩ אֲתֹנ֨וֹת צְחֹר֜וֹת יֹשְׁבֵ֧י עַל־ מִדִּ֛ין וְהֹלְכֵ֥י עַל־ דֶּ֖רֶךְ שִֽׂיחוּ׃
verses.transliteration: rō·ḵə·ḇê ’ă·ṯō·nō·wṯ ṣə·ḥō·rō·wṯ yō·šə·ḇê ‘al- mid·dîn wə·hō·lə·ḵê ‘al- de·reḵ śî·ḥū
verses.literal: You who ride white donkeys who sit on saddle blankets and you who travel . . . the road ponder
verses.literalPt: Vós os que cavalgais sobre jumentas brancas, que vos assentais em juízo, que andais pelo caminho, falai disto.

verses.original: מִקּ֣וֹל מְחַֽצְצִ֗ים בֵּ֚ין מַשְׁאַבִּ֔ים שָׁ֤ם יְתַנּוּ֙ צִדְק֣וֹת יְהוָ֔ה צִדְקֹ֥ת פִּרְזֹנ֖וֹ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אָ֛ז יָרְד֥וּ לַשְּׁעָרִ֖ים עַם־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: miq·qō·wl mə·ḥaṣ·ṣîm bên maš·’ab·bîm šām yə·ṯan·nū ṣiḏ·qō·wṯ Yah·weh ṣiḏ·qōṯ pir·zō·nōw bə·yiś·rā·’êl ’āz yā·rə·ḏū laš·šə·‘ā·rîm ‘am- Yah·weh
verses.literal: the voices of the singers at the watering places There they shall recount the righteous acts of the LORD the righteous deeds of His villagers in Israel Then the people of the LORD went down to the gates
verses.literalPt: Donde se ouve o estrondo dos flecheiros, entre os lugares onde se tiram águas, ali falai das justiças do SENHOR, das justiças que fez às suas aldeias em Israel; então o povo do SENHOR descia às portas.

verses.original: עוּרִ֤י עוּרִי֙ דְּבוֹרָ֔ה ע֥וּרִי ע֖וּרִי דַּבְּרִי־ שִׁ֑יר ק֥וּם בָּרָ֛ק וּֽשֲׁבֵ֥ה שֶׁבְיְךָ֖ בֶּן־ אֲבִינֹֽעַם׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ū·rî ‘ū·rî də·ḇō·w·rāh ‘ū·rî ‘ū·rî dab·bə·rî- šîr qūm bā·rāq ū·šă·ḇêh šeḇ·yə·ḵā ben- ’ă·ḇî·nō·‘am
verses.literal: Awake awake O Deborah Awake awake sing a song Arise O Barak and take hold of your captives O son of Abinoam
verses.literalPt: Desperta, desperta, Débora, desperta, desperta, entoa um cântico; levanta-te, Baraque, e leva presos os teus cativos, tu, filho de Abinoão.

verses.original: אָ֚ז יְרַ֣ד שָׂרִ֔יד לְאַדִּירִ֖ים עָ֑ם יְהוָ֕ה יְרַד־ לִ֖י בַּגִּבּוֹרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ’āz yə·raḏ śā·rîḏ lə·’ad·dî·rîm ‘ām Yah·weh yə·raḏ- lî bag·gib·bō·w·rîm
verses.literal: Then the survivors came down to the nobles the people of the LORD came down to me against the mighty
verses.literalPt: Então fez dominar sobre os nobres entre o povo, aos que restaram; fez-me o SENHOR dominar sobre os poderosos.

verses.original: מִנִּ֣י אֶפְרַ֗יִם שָׁרְשָׁם֙ בַּעֲמָלֵ֔ק אַחֲרֶ֥יךָ בִנְיָמִ֖ין בַּֽעֲמָמֶ֑יךָ מִנִּ֣י מָכִ֗יר יָֽרְדוּ֙ מְחֹ֣קְקִ֔ים וּמִ֨זְּבוּלֻ֔ן מֹשְׁכִ֖ים בְּשֵׁ֥בֶט סֹפֵֽר׃
verses.transliteration: min·nî ’ep̄·ra·yim šā·rə·šām ba·‘ă·mā·lêq ’a·ḥă·re·ḵā ḇin·yā·mîn ba·‘ă·mā·me·ḵā min·nî mā·ḵîr yā·rə·ḏū mə·ḥō·qə·qîm ū·miz·zə·ḇū·lun mō·šə·ḵîm bə·šê·ḇeṭ sō·p̄êr
verses.literal: Some came from Ephraim with their roots in Amalek Benjamin came with your people after you The commanders came down from Machir the bearers of the marshal’s staff from Zebulun
verses.literalPt: De Efraim saiu a sua raiz contra Amaleque; e depois de ti vinha Benjamim dentre os teus povos; de Maquir desceram os legisladores, e de Zebulom os que levaram a cana do escriba.

verses.original: וְשָׂרַ֤י בְּיִשָּׂשכָר֙ עִם־ דְּבֹרָ֔ה וְיִשָּׂשכָר֙ כֵּ֣ן בָּרָ֔ק בָּעֵ֖מֶק שֻׁלַּ֣ח בְּרַגְלָ֑יו בִּפְלַגּ֣וֹת רְאוּבֵ֔ן גְּדֹלִ֖ים חִקְקֵי־ לֵֽב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·śā·ray bə·yiś·śā·š·ḵār ‘im- də·ḇō·rāh wə·yiś·śā·š·ḵār kên bā·rāq bā·‘ê·meq šul·laḥ bə·raḡ·lāw bip̄·lag·gō·wṯ rə·’ū·ḇên gə·ḏō·lîm ḥiq·qê- lêḇ
verses.literal: The princes of Issachar were with Deborah and Issachar . . . was with Barak rushing into the valley at his heels In the clans of Reuben there was great indecision . . .
verses.literalPt: Também os principais de Issacar foram com Débora; e como Issacar, assim também Baraque, foi enviado a pé para o vale; nas divisões de Rúben foram grandes as resoluções do coração.

verses.original: לָ֣מָּה יָשַׁ֗בְתָּ בֵּ֚ין הַֽמִּשְׁפְּתַ֔יִם לִשְׁמֹ֖עַ שְׁרִק֣וֹת עֲדָרִ֑ים לִפְלַגּ֣וֹת רְאוּבֵ֔ן גְּדוֹלִ֖ים חִקְרֵי־ לֵֽב׃
verses.transliteration: lām·māh yā·šaḇ·tā bên ham·miš·pə·ṯa·yim liš·mō·a‘ šə·ri·qō·wṯ ‘ă·ḏā·rîm lip̄·lag·gō·wṯ rə·’ū·ḇên gə·ḏō·w·lîm ḥiq·rê- lêḇ
verses.literal: Why did you sit among the sheepfolds to hear the whistling for the flocks In the clans of Reuben there was great indecision . . .
verses.literalPt: Por que ficaste tu entre os currais para ouvires os balidos dos rebanhos? Nas divisões de Rúben tiveram grandes esquadrinhações do coração.

verses.original: גִּלְעָ֗ד בְּעֵ֤בֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן֙ שָׁכֵ֔ן וְדָ֕ן לָ֥מָּה יָג֖וּר אֳנִיּ֑וֹת אָשֵׁ֗ר יָשַׁב֙ לְח֣וֹף יַמִּ֔ים וְעַ֥ל מִפְרָצָ֖יו יִשְׁכּֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: gil·‘āḏ bə·‘ê·ḇer hay·yar·dên šā·ḵên wə·ḏān lām·māh yā·ḡūr ’o·nî·yō·wṯ ’ā·šêr yā·šaḇ lə·ḥō·wp̄ yam·mîm wə·‘al mip̄·rā·ṣāw yiš·kō·wn
verses.literal: Gilead remained beyond the Jordan Dan why did you linger by the ships Asher stayed at the coast . . . and remained in his harbors
verses.literalPt: Gileade ficou além do Jordão, e Dã por que se deteve nos navios? Aser se assentou na beira dos mares, e ficou junto às suas baías.

verses.original: זְבֻל֗וּן עַ֣ם חֵרֵ֥ף נַפְשׁ֛וֹ לָמ֖וּת וְנַפְתָּלִ֑י עַ֖ל מְרוֹמֵ֥י שָׂדֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: zə·ḇu·lūn ‘am ḥê·rêp̄ nap̄·šōw lā·mūṯ wə·nap̄·tā·lî ‘al mə·rō·w·mê śā·ḏeh
verses.literal: Zebulun was a people who risked . . . their lives Naphtali, too on the heights of the battlefield
verses.literalPt: Zebulom é um povo que expôs a sua vida à morte, como também Naftali, nas alturas do campo.

verses.original: בָּ֤אוּ מְלָכִים֙ נִלְחָ֔מוּ אָ֤ז נִלְחֲמוּ֙ מַלְכֵ֣י כְנַ֔עַן בְּתַעְנַ֖ךְ עַל־ מֵ֣י מְגִדּ֑וֹ בֶּ֥צַע כֶּ֖סֶף לֹ֥א לָקָֽחוּ׃
verses.transliteration: bā·’ū mə·lā·ḵîm nil·ḥā·mū ’āz nil·ḥă·mū mal·ḵê ḵə·na·‘an bə·ṯa‘·naḵ ‘al- mê mə·ḡid·dōw be·ṣa‘ ke·sep̄ lō lā·qā·ḥū
verses.literal: Kings came and fought then the kings of Canaan fought at Taanach by the waters of Megiddo but they took no plunder of silver
verses.literalPt: Vieram reis, pelejaram; então pelejaram os reis de Canaã em Taanaque, junto às águas de Megido; não tomaram despojo de prata.

verses.original: מִן־ שָׁמַ֖יִם נִלְחָ֑מוּ הַכּֽוֹכָבִים֙ מִמְּסִלּוֹתָ֔ם נִלְחֲמ֖וּ עִם־ סִיסְרָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: min- šā·ma·yim nil·ḥā·mū hak·kō·w·ḵā·ḇîm mim·mə·sil·lō·w·ṯām nil·ḥă·mū ‘im- sî·sə·rā
verses.literal: From the heavens the stars fought from their courses they fought against Sisera
verses.literalPt: Desde os céus pelejaram; até as estrelas desde os lugares dos seus cursos pelejaram contra Sísera.

verses.original: נַ֤חַל קִישׁוֹן֙ גְּרָפָ֔ם נַ֥חַל קְדוּמִ֖ים נַ֣חַל קִישׁ֑וֹן תִּדְרְכִ֥י נַפְשִׁ֖י עֹֽז׃
verses.transliteration: na·ḥal qî·šō·wn gə·rā·p̄ām na·ḥal qə·ḏū·mîm na·ḥal qî·šō·wn tiḏ·rə·ḵî nap̄·šî ‘ōz
verses.literal: The River Kishon swept them away the ancient river the River Kishon March on O my soul in strength
verses.literalPt: O ribeiro de Quisom os arrastou, aquele antigo ribeiro, o ribeiro de Quisom. Pisaste, ó minha alma, à força.

verses.original: אָ֥ז הָלְמ֖וּ עִקְּבֵי־ ס֑וּס מִֽדַּהֲר֖וֹת דַּהֲר֥וֹת אַבִּירָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: ’āz hā·lə·mū ‘iq·qə·ḇê- sūs mid·da·hă·rō·wṯ da·hă·rō·wṯ ’ab·bî·rāw
verses.literal: Then the hooves of horses thundered the mad galloping . . . of his stallions
verses.literalPt: Então os cascos dos cavalos se despedaçaram; pelo galopar, o galopar dos seus valentes.

verses.original: א֣וֹרוּ מֵר֗וֹז אָמַר֙ מַלְאַ֣ךְ יְהוָ֔ה אֹ֥רוּ אָר֖וֹר יֹשְׁבֶ֑יהָ כִּ֤י לֹֽא־ בָ֙אוּ֙ לְעֶזְרַ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה לְעֶזְרַ֥ת יְהוָ֖ה בַּגִּבּוֹרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ’ō·w·rū mê·rō·wz ’ā·mar mal·’aḵ Yah·weh ’ō·rū ’ā·rō·wr yō·šə·ḇe·hā kî lō- ḇā·’ū lə·‘ez·raṯ Yah·weh lə·‘ez·raṯ Yah·weh bag·gib·bō·w·rîm
verses.literal: Curse Meroz says the angel of the LORD Bitterly curse . . . her inhabitants for they did not come to help the LORD to help the LORD against the mighty
verses.literalPt: Amaldiçoai a Meroz, diz o anjo do SENHOR, acremente amaldiçoai aos seus moradores; porquanto não vieram ao socorro do SENHOR, ao socorro do SENHOR com os valorosos.

verses.original: תְּבֹרַךְ֙ מִנָּשִׁ֔ים יָעֵ֕ל אֵ֖שֶׁת חֶ֣בֶר הַקֵּינִ֑י מִנָּשִׁ֥ים בָּאֹ֖הֶל תְּבֹרָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: tə·ḇō·raḵ min·nā·šîm yā·‘êl ’ê·šeṯ ḥe·ḇer haq·qê·nî min·nā·šîm bā·’ō·hel tə·ḇō·rāḵ
verses.literal: Most blessed among women is Jael the wife of Heber the Kenite most blessed of tent-dwelling women
verses.literalPt: Bendita seja entre as mulheres, Jael, mulher de Héber, o queneu; bendita seja entre as mulheres nas tendas.

verses.original: מַ֥יִם שָׁאַ֖ל חָלָ֣ב נָתָ֑נָה בְּסֵ֥פֶל אַדִּירִ֖ים הִקְרִ֥יבָה חֶמְאָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ma·yim šā·’al ḥā·lāḇ nā·ṯā·nāh bə·sê·p̄el ’ad·dî·rîm hiq·rî·ḇāh ḥem·’āh
verses.literal: He asked for water and she gave him milk In a magnificent bowl she brought him curds
verses.literalPt: Água pediu ele, leite lhe deu ela; em prato de nobres lhe ofereceu manteiga.

verses.original: יָדָהּ֙ לַיָּתֵ֣ד תִּשְׁלַ֔חְנָה וִֽימִינָ֖הּ לְהַלְמ֣וּת עֲמֵלִ֑ים וְהָלְמָ֤ה סִֽיסְרָא֙ מָחֲקָ֣ה רֹאשׁ֔וֹ וּמָחֲצָ֥ה וְחָלְפָ֖ה רַקָּתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: yā·ḏāh lay·yā·ṯêḏ tiš·laḥ·nāh wî·mî·nāh lə·hal·mūṯ ‘ă·mê·lîm wə·hā·lə·māh sî·sə·rā mā·ḥă·qāh rō·šōw ū·mā·ḥă·ṣāh wə·ḥā·lə·p̄āh raq·qā·ṯōw
verses.literal: She reached for the tent peg her right hand for the workman’s hammer She struck Sisera and crushed his skull she shattered and pierced his temple
verses.literalPt: À estaca estendeu a sua mão esquerda, e ao martelo dos trabalhadores a sua direita; e matou a Sísera, e rachou-lhe a cabeça, quando lhe pregou e atravessou as fontes.

verses.original: בֵּ֣ין רַגְלֶ֔יהָ כָּרַ֥ע נָפַ֖ל שָׁכָ֑ב בֵּ֤ין רַגְלֶ֙יהָ֙ כָּרַ֣ע נָפָ֔ל בַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר כָּרַ֔ע שָׁ֖ם נָפַ֥ל שָׁדֽוּד׃
verses.transliteration: bên raḡ·le·hā kā·ra‘ nā·p̄al šā·ḵāḇ bên raḡ·le·hā kā·ra‘ nā·p̄āl ba·’ă·šer kā·ra‘ šām nā·p̄al šā·ḏūḏ
verses.literal: At her feet he collapsed he fell there he lay still at her feet he collapsed he fell where he collapsed there he fell dead
verses.literalPt: Entre os seus pés se encurvou, caiu, ficou estirado; entre os seus pés se encurvou, caiu; onde se encurvou, ali ficou abatido.

verses.original: בְּעַד֩ הַחַלּ֨וֹן נִשְׁקְפָ֧ה וַתְּיַבֵּ֛ב אֵ֥ם סִֽיסְרָ֖א בְּעַ֣ד הָֽאֶשְׁנָ֑ב מַדּ֗וּעַ בֹּשֵׁ֤שׁ רִכְבּוֹ֙ לָב֔וֹא מַדּ֣וּעַ אֶֽחֱר֔וּ פַּעֲמֵ֖י מַרְכְּבוֹתָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: bə·‘aḏ ha·ḥal·lō·wn niš·qə·p̄āh wat·tə·yab·bêḇ ’êm sî·sə·rā bə·‘aḏ hā·’eš·nāḇ mad·dū·a‘ bō·šêš riḵ·bōw lā·ḇō·w mad·dū·a‘ ’e·ḥĕ·rū pa·‘ă·mê mar·kə·ḇō·w·ṯāw
verses.literal: Sisera’s mother looked through the window she peered through the lattice and lamented Why is his chariot so long in coming What has delayed the clatter of his chariots
verses.literalPt: A mãe de Sísera olhava pela janela, e exclamava pela grade: Por que tarda em vir o seu carro? Por que se demoram os ruídos dos seus carros?

verses.original: חַכְמ֥וֹת שָׂרוֹתֶ֖יהָ תַּעֲנֶ֑ינָּה אַף־ הִ֕יא תָּשִׁ֥יב אֲמָרֶ֖יהָ לָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: ḥaḵ·mō·wṯ śā·rō·w·ṯe·hā ta·‘ă·nen·nāh ’ap̄- hî tā·šîḇ ’ă·mā·re·hā lāh
verses.literal: Her wisest ladies answer indeed she keeps telling herself
verses.literalPt: As mais sábias das suas damas responderam; e até ela respondia a si mesma:

verses.original: הֲלֹ֨א יִמְצְא֜וּ יְחַלְּק֣וּ שָׁלָ֗ל רַ֤חַם רַחֲמָתַ֙יִם֙ לְרֹ֣אשׁ גֶּ֔בֶר שְׁלַ֤ל צְבָעִים֙ לְסִ֣יסְרָ֔א שְׁלַ֥ל צְבָעִ֖ים רִקְמָ֑ה צֶ֥בַע רִקְמָתַ֖יִם לְצַוְּארֵ֥י שָׁלָֽל׃
verses.transliteration: hă·lō yim·ṣə·’ū yə·ḥal·lə·qū šā·lāl ra·ḥam ra·ḥă·mā·ṯa·yim lə·rōš ge·ḇer šə·lal ṣə·ḇā·‘îm lə·sî·sə·rā šə·lal ṣə·ḇā·‘îm riq·māh ṣe·ḇa‘ riq·mā·ṯa·yim lə·ṣaw·wə·rê šā·lāl
verses.literal: Are they not finding and dividing the spoil a girl or two for each warrior a plunder of dyed garments for Sisera the spoil of embroidered . . . . . . garments for the neck of the looter
verses.literalPt: Porventura não achariam e repartiriam despojos? Uma ou duas moças a cada homem? Para Sísera despojos de estofos coloridos, despojos de estofos coloridos bordados; de estofos coloridos bordados de ambos os lados como despojo para os pescoços.

verses.original: כֵּ֠ן יֹאבְד֤וּ כָל־ אוֹיְבֶ֙יךָ֙ יְהוָ֔ה וְאֹ֣הֲבָ֔יו כְּצֵ֥את הַשֶּׁ֖מֶשׁ בִּגְבֻרָת֑וֹ וַתִּשְׁקֹ֥ט הָאָ֖רֶץ אַרְבָּעִ֥ים שָׁנָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: kên yō·ḇə·ḏū ḵāl ’ō·wy·ḇe·ḵā Yah·weh wə·’ō·hă·ḇāw kə·ṣêṯ haš·še·meš biḡ·ḇu·rā·ṯōw wat·tiš·qōṭ hā·’ā·reṣ ’ar·bā·‘îm šā·nāh
verses.literal: So may all Your enemies perish O LORD But may those who love You shine like the sun at its brightest And the land had rest for forty years
verses.literalPt: Assim, ó SENHOR, pereçam todos os teus inimigos! Porém os que te amam sejam como o sol quando sai na sua força. (5:32)E sossegou a terra quarenta anos.
